sentences.imageNotes: 明亮的手工樂器工作室，桌上展示幾件已完成、可辨識的木製或竹製樂器，例如竹笛、小木鼓和搖鈴。generic adult instrument maker 正在為另一件半成品做手工收尾，桌邊有少量木料與工具，主角女孩欣賞已完成的樂器。讓「這些樂器」與手工製作的來源有明確連結，不要畫成一般玩具或全部尚未完成的零件。
sentences.imagePrompt: ONE square children's storybook illustration L445-S01. Input collage full first row L058 STYLE ONLY plus second-row refined examples: rich warm layered gouache and fine colored pencil, luminous natural light, detailed wood/plant setting, expressive natural faces and stable child proportions, not anime/flat cartoon/thin watercolor. Fixed protagonist girl from pink cardigan examples: short dark bob, pink hairclip, cream shirt navy skirt, admiring completed handmade instruments on a workbench. Bright adult artisan instrument-making workshop: clearly recognizable FINISHED bamboo transverse flute with finger holes, small wooden drum with taut drumhead, wooden shaker/rattle displayed together. A generic adult artisan with distinct mature face and work apron hand-finishes a separate half-made instrument, few offcuts and hand tools connect finished instruments with handmade source. Girl looks at finished instruments with interest; do not make all objects unfinished parts or generic toys. No readable text/letters/numbers/labels/logos on instruments, walls, tools, clothes or anywhere. One coherent scene, safe margins, square full bleed. Do not reproduce collage.

Contact sheet references FULL L058 first row for STYLE ONLY plus refined second row: warm rich layered gouache and fine colored-pencil texture, detailed setting, natural adult proportions expressive faces, no anime/flatcartoon/simple thin watercolor. Three distinct GENERIC ADULT band members loading recognizable musical instruments into a parked small van with rear doors wide open. One carries small wooden drum, second carries a full visible acoustic stringed instrument with strings and soundhole, third slides instrument case into cargo area. At least two instrument bodies fully identifiable; people WALK/CARRY, not performing. Stationary van beside leafy quiet venue courtyard, warm daylight. sentences.text: 我很樂意教你操作機器人。
sentences.spokenText: 我很樂意教你操作機器人
sentences.imageNotes:
主角女孩與固定「你」小男孩在桌邊玩小型輪式機器人。小男孩拿著控制器，女孩親切地指向控制按鍵並示範操作，表示願意教他；機器人放在兩人看得到的桌面區域。
「我」使用固定主角女孩；「你」使用短深色髮、天藍上衣、綠短褲的固定小男孩，不改成小光或 generic child。場景重點是樂意教人，不是學會後歡呼或拿到比賽獎盃。
sentences.imagePrompt: ONE square illustration L445-S03. Reference collage: all five first-row L058 STYLE ONLY with refined second-row rich warm gouache/colored-pencil preferred proportions. CAST specifically fixed girl short dark bob pink hairclip/pink cardigan cream top navy skirt; fixed YOU boy from L058-S04/S05: short slightly tousled BLACK hair, skyblue shirt and GREEN shorts, no glasses, not Xiaoguang, not striped brother. At wooden table both children look at a small friendly wheeled robot on clear tabletop. Boy holds remote controller; girl kindly points to one plain controller button demonstrating how to operate, warm willing-to-teach expression. Clear teacher-helper girl and learning boy roles; no celebrating win/trophy. Convincing two hands per child, natural child anatomy, expressive almond eyes matching refs, detailed warm room with plants and sunlight. Robot plain and friendly no lettering or screen words, controller no text/numbers. No text logos labels symbols or watermark anywhere. Match sophisticated layered pigment/textures, avoid generic round cartoon/anime/flatvector/pale thinwatercolor. Square fullbleed safe margins, coherent scene no collage.

sentences.text: 我們坐飛機去看體操比賽。
sentences.spokenText: 我們坐飛機去看體操比賽
sentences.imageNotes: 固定主角一家四口在飛機客艙就座：主角女孩、哥哥、媽媽、爸爸。清楚呈現客艙座椅和飛機舷窗；以女孩的想像泡泡呈現抵達後要觀看的體操比賽，一位 generic gymnast 在體操墊上做穩定的平衡動作。飛機上是正在前往，泡泡是期待觀看的賽事；不要把體操表演畫在飛機走道，也不要把家人畫成參賽選手。無需票券、螢幕文字或賽事標題。
sentences.imagePrompt: ONE square children's storybook illustration L445-S04. First input collage FULL first-row L058 STYLE ONLY and refined second row for warm detailed layered gouache and colored-pencil rendering. Second input is FIXED FAMILY CAST: mother shoulder dark bob cream blouse blue jeans, father short dark hair open blue overshirt white tee tan pants, girl bob pinkclip pinkcardigan navyskirt, older brother short dark hair blue-and-white STRIPED shirt. EXACTLY these FOUR family members seated inside passenger AIRPLANE cabin, natural seatbelts and distinct seatbacks/windows make flight obvious. Compose across two adjacent rows or seatgroups so all four recognizable faces visible, no extra family. Girl imagines destination gymnastics competition: ONE large soft-edged wordless thought bubble clearly linked to her, showing a GENERIC gymnast in simple sportswear holding a stable balance pose ON A GYM MAT in a gymnasium. Main family are travelers going to watch, NOT competitors; gymnast ONLY in thoughtbubble, never in airplane aisle. Calm excited anticipation, no tickets/screens with text, no plane branding, numbers, letters, captions or logos anywhere. Natural family proportions, detailed upholstered cabin and warm daylight, rich refined reference texture, avoid anime/flatsimplecartoon/pale watercolor. Square safe margins.

sentences.imageNotes: 主角家客廳，窗外清楚可見雨滴和濕潤景色；主角女孩與固定主角媽媽在室內空曠處做伸展、抬手等簡單運動。用窗外下雨與室內運動的對照呈現改在家活動；不畫成站在雨中，也不在室內打球。
